paite: Toupa PATHIAN thu ka kiang ah ahong tung nawn a,
heading: Tura Kumpipa Kalh A Genkholhna

paite: "Mihing tapa, Tura heutupa kiang ah gen inla, Toupa PATHIAN in, hichi in achi: Na lungsim akisathei a, Pathian ka hi a, tuipi lai a Pathian tutmun ah ka tu, na chi a; himahleh mihing lel na hi a, pathian na hi kei a, pathian lungsim bang in kingaihtuah mah lechin;
Daniel sang in na pilzaw a, na lak ah thuguk a-om thei kei a;
na pilna leh na lemtheihna in na na kihihhau a; na goubawm ah dangka leh dangka-eng na khum hi.
Na pilna thupi mahmah leh na sumsaina in sum na hihpung a; na hauhsak ziak in na lungsim ana kisatheita hi."
Huaiziak in Toupa PATHIAN in hichi in achi: "Pathian lungsim bang pu a na kingaihtuah ziak in,
ngai in, na kiang ah gamdangmi, nam lauhuaitak ka hon pilut sin ahi; huan, na pilna gah kilawm tung ah anamsau uh alek ding ua, na thupina ahihse ding uh.
Khuk thuk ah ahon sawllut ding ua, tuipi lai a athahte uh sih in na si ding.
Nang hon thatmi ma ah, Pathian ka hi, na chi lailai dia hia? Nang hon liamsakmi khut ah pathian na hi kei a, mihing lel na hi zaw.
Pau tuam mite khut ah, zeksum louh sih in na si ding; ka pauta ngal a," chih Toupa PATHIAN thupawt ahi.
Huai lou leng ka kiang ah TOUPA thu ahong tung hi.
heading: Tura Kumpipa Pukna

paite: "Mihing tapa, Tura kumpipa suunna la phuak inla, akiang ah, Hichi in Toupa PATHIAN in achi: Hoih buchingtak, pilna a dim, kilawmna chiteng;

Pathian huan, Eden ah na teng a; suangmantam chiteng in na kituam a, sardi, topaz leh diamond, beril, onik, jasper, sapphir, emerald, karbankul, aphumkipna leh agelh kilawmna dangka-eng a bawlte, nang siam ni a kisiamte.
Nang chingmi cherub sathau nilh na hi; Pathian tang siangthou ah ka hon omsak a, meisuangte lak ah na vak hi.
Na hoih buching; siam a na om ni a kipan, nang a diktatlouhna a-om mateng in.
Na sumsinna apun hulhul ziak in hiamgamna in na dim a, khelhna ah na pukta hi. Pathian tang a kipan in bangmah lou in ka hon paita a; chingmi cherub in meisuangte lak a kipan ahon delhkhia hi.
Na kilawmna ziak a hong kisathei in, na thupina a na pilna hihsia in, lei ah ka hon pai a, etnop ding in kumpipate ma ah mual ah ka hon phou hi.

Na sumsin diktatlouhnate ah, na siatna ziak in, na mun siangthoute na hihbuah a, huaiziak in mei ka khah a; na sung a kipan ahong kangbei a, ahon musekte tengteng muh in lei ah leivui ka hon suaksakta.
Mite lak a ahon thei peuhmah lamdangsak, launa na hong suakta; na om ngei nawn kei ding," chi in.
Huan ka kiang ah TOUPA thu ahong tung a:
heading: Sidon Dem A Genlawkna

paite: "Mihing tapa, Sidon masuan inla, atungthu gen in.
Hichi in Toupa PATHIAN in achi: Ka hon nang ahi, aw Sidon, ka hihlang ding, ka thupina; nang ah TOUPA ka hihdan athei ding ua, amah ah vai ka hawm hun chiang in, ka sianthouna ka ensak mahmah ding.
Akongzing ah sisan leh hipi ka tungsak ding, asung ah miliam apuk ding; mun kil chih a kipan namsau in. Huan TOUPA ka hi chih athei ding uh.
"Huchi in Israel inkote sun ding loulingnei a-om kei ding a, akim a amau musit mite lak ah hihna ding ling a-omta kei ding; kei Toupa PATHIAN ka hi chih athei ding uh."
heading: Israel Vualzawl In A-om Ding

paite: Hichi in Toupa PATHIAN in achi hi: "Israel inkote adalhna gam mite lak a kipan ka pikhawm nawn hun chiang in Jakob kiang a ka piak, agam mahmah uah atengta ding uh,

Huchi in bittak in a-omta ding ua; ahi, innte alam ding ua; grephuante abawl ding uh. Bittak in a-om ding ua; akim ua musit mite tengteng tung a vai ka hawm chiang in kei TOUPA a Pathian uh ka hi chih athei ding uh," chi in.
